standards.label: HEIR — Homomorphic Encryption Intermediate Representation
standards.notes: Open-source (not IETF); basis for HE inference concepts in pkg/inference

standards.label: PQC Migration Framework — pqcframework.org
standards.notes: Comprehensive 8-phase PQC migration programme; defines CBOM, TNFL threat class, five-dimensional crypto agility model. Informs Discovery tab, Agility tab operational section, and hybrid PQC caveats.

standards.label: ASD — Preparing for Post-Quantum Cryptography
standards.notes: Australian Signals Directorate guidance. Explicitly advises hybrid PQC is case-by-case, not a universal first step. Cryptographic discovery is identified as the critical starting point.

standards.label: ASD — Stay Ahead of the Quantum Threat
standards.notes: Feb 2026 ASD article. ISM mandates cessation of traditional asymmetric crypto by end of 2030. Milestones: refined plan by 2026, commence critical systems by 2028, complete by 2030. CBOM (cryptographic bill of materials) named as key planning concept. ML-KEM and ML-DSA as recommended algorithms. APRA-regulated entities must start mapping crypto dependencies.

standards.label: NIST SP 800-208 — Stateful Hash-Based Signature Schemes
standards.notes: Standardises LMS and XMSS stateful hash-based signatures. Required by CNSA 2.0 for software and firmware signing — the one signature migration NSA says to begin immediately. Deploy-now Track B option; requires HSM-backed state management (key-state reuse is catastrophic). Not the same as FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA, which is stateless).
